step1_analysis.description: A cross-coupled LC VCO with capacitive cross-coupling and varactor tuning, used as the local oscillator in a 12-GHz dual-conversion receiver.

paper_reference.title: A 12-GHz Silicon Bipolar Dual-Conversion Receiver for Digital Satellite Applications

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 1nH inductor and ~0.9pF total tank capacitance.
Depends heavily on inductor Q and active device noise.

voltage_swing.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the tank

sky130_expected.reasoning: With 5mA tail current and ~300 ohm tank parallel resistance, swing is ~1.5V.

power_consumption.description: DC power consumption of the VCO core

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure oscillation frequency, voltage swing, and power consumption of the LC VCO.
step3_testbench.spice:
* VCO Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=10u L_xm1=0.15u

* DUT
R1 N4 GND 10k
L1 VCC N1 1n
I1 N0 GND 5m
R2 N8 GND 10k
L2 VCC N3 1n
R3 N5 VB 10k
R4 N6 VB 10k
C1 N1 N4 1p
D1 N4 VTUNE varactor
C2 VTUNE GND 10p
C3 VTUNE GND 10p
Q1 N3 N6 N0 npn
D2 N8 VTUNE varactor
C4 N1 N6 1p
C5 N3 N5 1p
C6 N3 N8 1p
Q2 N1 N5 N0 npn

* Models
.model npn npn (is=1e-16 bf=100)
.model varactor d (cjo=1p m=0.5 vj=0.8)

* Sources
VVCC VCC 0 1.8
VVB VB 0 0.9
VVTUNE VTUNE 0 0.9

* Initial conditions to start oscillation
.ic v(N1)=1.8 v(N3)=1.7

.control
* Transient analysis
tran 1p 10n

* Measure oscillation frequency
meas tran t1 trig v(N1) val=1.8 rise=20 targ v(N1) val=1.8 rise=21
let f_osc = 1 / t1
print f_osc

* Measure voltage swing
meas tran vmax max v(N1) from=5n to=10n
meas tran vmin min v(N1) from=5n to=10n
let vswing = vmax - vmin
print vswing

* Measure power
op
let power = -i(VVCC) * 1.8
print power

quit
.endc
.end
